noticias.titular: Dodgers' Blake Snell (groin) exits vs. Reds after one inning
noticias.texto: Dodgers left-hander Blake Snell left his start Wednesday night against the Reds after an inning because of left groin tightness.
Athletics activated LHP Joe Rock.
Tampa Bay Rays placed RHP Tyler Wells on the 15-day injured list retroactive to September 13, 2026. Right forearm tightness.
Tampa Bay Rays activated RF Jake Fraley from the 60-day injured list.
Colorado Rockies activated LHP Kyle Freeland from the 15-day injured list.
Athletics placed LHP Gage Jump on the 15-day injured list retroactive to September 13, 2026. Left shoulder impingement.
Tampa Bay Rays recalled RHP Alex Cook from Durham Bulls.
Athletics recalled LHP Joe Rock from Las Vegas Aviators.
Colorado Rockies optioned SS Vimael Machín to Albuquerque Isotopes.
Tampa Bay Rays optioned C Kenny Piper to Durham Bulls.
Colorado Rockies recalled DH Braxton Fulford from Albuquerque Isotopes.
Colorado Rockies optioned RHP Blas Castaño to Albuquerque Isotopes.
Los Angeles Dodgers activated LHP Kris Bubic from the 60-day injured list.
Los Angeles Dodgers designated LF Ryan Ward for assignment.
Los Angeles Dodgers optioned RHP Paul Gervase to Oklahoma City Comets.
Colorado Rockies optioned LHP Sean Sullivan to Albuquerque Isotopes.
Tampa Bay Rays activated SS Taylor Walls from the 10-day injured list.
Tampa Bay Rays optioned 3B Nick Madrigal to Durham Bulls.
Los Angeles Dodgers optioned RHP Bobby Miller to Oklahoma City Comets.
Los Angeles Dodgers recalled RHP Landon Knack from Oklahoma City Comets.
